examples.text: seyyathā'pi, brāhmaṇa, puriso daḷiddo assako anāḷhiyo. tassa akāmassa bilaṃ olaggeyyuṃ, idaṃ te, ambho purisa, maṃsaṃ khāditabbaṃ, mūlañ'ca anuppadātabban'ti.
na taṃ daḷhaṃ bandhanam'āhu dhīrā, yadāyasaṃ dārujapabbajañ'ca, sārattarattā maṇikuṇḍalesu, puttesu dāresu ca yā apekkhā.
moneyyaṃ te upaññissaṃ, dukkaraṃ durabhisambhavaṃ, handa te naṃ pavakkhāmi, santhambhassu daḷho bhava.

32202.commentary: (SNa) yāyaṃ paṭipadā daḷhā'ti ayaṃ dhamm'ānudhammapaṭipadā daḷhā thirā. (SNt) paṭipakkhavidhamane asithilatāya daḷhā.

examples.text: na y'idaṃ bhāsitamattena, ek'antasavanena vā, anukkamitave sakkā, yāyaṃ paṭipadā daḷhā, yāya dhīrā pamuccanti, jhāyino mārabandhanā.

32208.meaning1: dogmatic; fixed in view; entrenched in a belief
32208.commentary: (MNa) adaḷhadiṭṭhī'ti anādānadiṭṭhī suṃsumāraṃ hadaye pakkhipanto viya daḷhaṃ na gaṇhāti.

examples.text: sace pana, bhikkhave, evam'assa, mayhaṃ kho vihesā bhavissati parassa ca puggalassa anupaghāto. paro hi puggalo akkodhano anupanāhī daḷhadiṭṭhī duppaṭinissaggī, sakkomi c'āhaṃ etaṃ puggalaṃ akusalā vuṭṭhāpetvā kusale patiṭṭhāpetuṃ. appamattakaṃ kho pan'etaṃ yadidaṃ, mayhaṃ vihesā.

32209.commentary: (MNa) daḷhadhanu nāma dvisahassathāmaṃ vuccati, dvisahassathāmaṃ nāma yassa āropitassa jiyābaddho lohasīs'ādīnaṃ bhāro daṇḍe gahetvā yāva kaṇḍappamāṇā ukkhittassa pathavito muccati.

32210.meaning1: with a strong bow; armed with a firm bow
32210.construction:
daḷha + dhanu + a
daḷhadhanu + a > daḷhadhanva > daḷhadhamma
32210.commentary: (SNa) daḷhadhammo'ti daḷhadhanu, uttamappamāṇena dhanunā samannāgato. (ANa) daḷhadhammo'ti daḷhadhanuṃ gahetvā ṭhito.

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, evarūpo javo ahosi, seyyathā'pi nāma daḷhadhammo dhanuggaho sikkhito katahattho kat'ūpāsano lahukena asanena appakasirena tiriyaṃ tālacchāyaṃ atipāteyya.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, cattāro daḷhadhammā dhanuggahā susikkhitā katahatthā kat'ūpāsanā catuddisā ṭhitā assu.

32212.construction:
daḷha + dhanu + a + ī
daḷhadhamma + ī

examples.text: uggaputtā mah'issāsā, sikkhitā daḷhadhammino, samantā parikireyyuṃ, sahassaṃ apalāyinaṃ.
bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā daḷhanemi nāma ahosi cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato.

32215.meaning1: having persistent effort; making continuous effort; striving diligently

examples.text: te jhāyino sātatikā, niccaṃ daḷhaparakkamā, phusanti dhīrā nibbānaṃ, yogakkhemaṃ anuttaraṃ.
āraddhavīriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya, thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu.

32216.meaning1: with strong encircling wall and gateway
32216.commentary: (SNa) daḷhapākāratoraṇan'ti thirapākārañ'c'eva thiratoraṇañ'ca. toraṇāni nāma hi puris'ubbedhāni nagarassa alaṅ'kār'atthaṃ karīyanti, coranivāraṇ'atthāni'pi honti'y'eva. atha vā toraṇan'ti piṭṭhasaṅghāṭass'etaṃ nāmaṃ, thirapiṭṭhasaṅghāṭan'ti'pi attho.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhu, rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ daḷh'uddhāpaṃ daḷhapākāratoraṇaṃ chadvāraṃ. tatr'assa dovāriko paṇḍito byatto medhāvī, aññātānaṃ nivāretā, ñātānaṃ pavesetā.

32220.meaning1: firmly this; strongly this; vigorously this

examples.text: kayirā ce kayirāth'enaṃ, daḷham'enaṃ parakkame, sithilo hi paribbājo, bhiyyo ākirate rajaṃ.

32222.meaning1: firmly undertaking; resolutely taking upon oneself

examples.text: yam'pi, bhikkhave, tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussabhūto samāno daḷhasamādāno ahosi kusalesu dhammesu, avatthitasamādāno kāyasucarite vacīsucarite manosucarite

32223.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of daḷha
32223.construction:
√dah + ta > daḍha > daḷha + aṃ
daḷha + aṃ

examples.text: uṭṭhahatha nisīdatha, daḷhaṃ sikkhatha santiyā, mā vo pamatte viññāya, maccurājā amohayittha vas'ānuge.
idh'eva suddhi iti vādayanti, n'āññesu dhammesu visuddhim'āhu, evam'pi titthyā puthuso niviṭṭhā, sak'āyane daḷhaṃ vadānā.

32224.construction:
√dah + ta > daḍha > daḷha + ika
daḷha + ika

32225.construction:
√dah + ta > daḍha > daḷha + ī
daḷha + ī

examples.text: ye te bhikkhū tiracchānakathikā kāyadaḷhibahulā viharanti tesam'pi ekajjhaṃ sen'āsanaṃ paññapeti, imāya'p'ime āyasmanto ratiyā acchissantī'ti.

32226.meaning1: consolidation; strengthening; affirmation; action which strengthens

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhante, rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ daḷh'uddāpaṃ daḷhapākāratoraṇaṃ ekadvāraṃ, tatr'assa dovāriko paṇḍito viyatto medhāvī aññātānaṃ nivāretā ñātānaṃ pavesetā
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhu, rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ daḷh'uddhāpaṃ daḷhapākāratoraṇaṃ chadvāraṃ. tatr'assa dovāriko paṇḍito byatto medhāvī, aññātānaṃ nivāretā, ñātānaṃ pavesetā.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, ahi gūthagato kiñ'c'āpi na daṃsati, atha kho naṃ makkheti, evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, kiñ'c'āpi evarūpassa puggalassa na diṭṭh'ānugatiṃ āpajjati, atha kho naṃ pāpako kittisaddo abbhuggacchati, pāpamitto purisapuggalo pāpasahāyo pāpasampavaṅko'ti.
482, 508. dā'd'antass'aṃ mi mesu.
499, 507. dā dhātussa dajjaṃ.

32232.meaning1: with teeth; having (a certain kind of) teeth; -toothed
32232.commentary: (MNa) susukkadāṭho'ti aññesañ'ca pūtidantā uṭṭhahanti, tena kāci dāṭhā kāḷā'pi vivaṇṇā'pi honti.

examples.text: susukkadāṭho kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.

32233.meaning2: strong-toothed; whose strength is his teeth

examples.text: nivāto nāma nīcamanatā nivātavuttitā, yāya samannāgato puggalo nihatamāno nihatadappo pādapuñchanakacoḷasadiso chinnavisāṇa-usabhasamo uddhaṭadāṭhasappasamo ca hutvā saṇho sakhilo sukhasambhāso hoti, ayaṃ nivāto.
ekā'hi dāṭhā tidivehi pūjitā, ekā pana gandhārapure mahīyati, kāliṅgarañño vijite pun'ekaṃ, ekaṃ pana nāgarājā maheti.

32237.meaning2: whose strength lies in his tusks

32241.commentary: (THa) dāṭhīnan'ti dāṭhāvantānaṃ. pasaṭṭhadāṭhīnaṃ, atisayadāṭhānan'ti vā attho. yathā hi sīhā ativiya daḷhānaṃ tikkhānañ'ca catunnaṃ dāṭhānaṃ balena paṭipakkhaṃ abhibhavitvā attano manorathaṃ matthakaṃ pūrenti, evam'ete'pi catunnaṃ ariyamaggadāṭhānaṃ balena anādimati saṃsāre anabhibhūtapubbapaṭipakkhaṃ abhibhavitvā attano manorathaṃ matthakaṃ pāpesuṃ. idhā'pi dāṭhā viyā'ti dāṭhā'ti sadisakappanāvasen'eva attho veditabbo.

examples.text: sīhānaṃ'va nadantānaṃ, dāṭhīnaṃ girigabbhare, suṇātha bhāvit'attānaṃ, gāthā atth'ūpanāyikā.
soṇā dhaṅkā siṅgālā ca, ye c'aññe santi dāṭhino, ajarā nūna hessanti, bhakkhayitvā pabhāvatiṃ.

32243.meaning1: should be given; to be provided

examples.text: kālass'eva vuṭṭhāya upāhanā omuñcitvā ek'aṃsaṃ uttar'āsaṅgaṃ karitvā dantakaṭṭhaṃ dātabbaṃ, mukh'odakaṃ dātabbaṃ, āsanaṃ paññapetabbaṃ.
sace tattha āgacchati so vattabbo, āvuso, kīdisaṃ te bhaṇḍan'ti? sace rūpena vā nimittena vā sampādeti dātabbaṃ, no ce sampādeti vicināhi āvuso'ti vattabbo.
dātā ca ahosi sukhumānaṃ mudukānaṃ attharaṇānaṃ pāvuraṇānaṃ khomasukhumānaṃ kappāsikasukhumānaṃ koseyyasukhumānaṃ kambalasukhumānaṃ
sa pattapāṇi vicaranto, amūgo mūgasammato, appaṃ dānaṃ na hīḷeyya, dātāraṃ n'āvajāniyā.

32247.meaning1: who gives; giver; bestower (of something to someone)

examples.text: puna capar'āhaṃ, bhante, ime isidattapurāṇā thapatayo mamabhattā mamayānā, ahaṃ nesaṃ jīvikāya dātā, yasassa āhattā, atha ca pana no tathā mayi nipaccakāraṃ karonti yathā bhagavati.

32248.meaning1: wanting to give; wishing to offer (to)

examples.text: tassā te ñātakā sāmikaṃ acchinditvā aññassa dātu'kāmā. sā ca taṃ na icchati.

32250.meaning1: to give; to offer; to donate
32250.meaning2: to give, to offer, to hand over

examples.text: evam'etaṃ, sumane! alañ'hi, sumane, dānāni dātuṃ alaṃ puññāni kātuṃ

andhabālapitaraṃ nissāya evarūpaṃ buddhaṃ upasaṅkamitvā kāyaveyyāvaṭikaṃ vā kātuṃ dānaṃ vā dātuṃ dhammaṃ vā sotuṃ n'ālatthaṃ, idāni me hatthā'pi anadhipateyyā, aññaṃ kattabbaṃ n'atthī'ti manam'eva pasādesi.
evam'etaṃ, sumane! alañ'hi, sumane, dānāni dātuṃ alaṃ puññāni kātuṃ

andhabālapitaraṃ nissāya evarūpaṃ buddhaṃ upasaṅkamitvā kāyaveyyāvaṭikaṃ vā kātuṃ dānaṃ vā dātuṃ dhammaṃ vā sotuṃ n'ālatthaṃ, idāni me hatthā'pi anadhipateyyā, aññaṃ kattabbaṃ n'atthī'ti manam'eva pasādesi.
tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, catūsu dvāresu dānaṃ dīyittha samaṇa-brāhmaṇa-kapaṇ'addhika-vanibbaka-yācakānaṃ
ekam'antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ bhagavā etadavoca, api nu te, gahapati, kule dānaṃ dīyatī'ti? dīyati me, bhante, kule dānaṃ. tañ'ca kho lūkhaṃ kaṇājakaṃ biḷaṅgadutiyan'ti.
atha kho āyasmā raṭṭhapālo sakapitu nivesane n'eva dānaṃ alattha na paccakkhānaṃ, añña'd'atthu akkosam'eva alattha

32256.meaning1: talk about giving; discussion about charity

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā brahm'āyussa brāhmaṇassa anupubbiṃ kathaṃ kathesi, seyyath'idaṃ, dānakathaṃ, sīlakathaṃ, saggakathaṃ, kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṃkilesaṃ nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.

32258.commentary: (DNa) alaṃ dān'ajja uyyānabhūmiyā'ti, ajja uyyānabhūmiṃ passissāmā'ti gacchāma, alaṃ tāya uyyānabhūmiyā'ti saṃviggahadayo saṃveg'ānurūpam'āha.

examples.text: tena hi, samma migava, alaṃ dān'ajja uyyānabhūmiyā. tam'eva dāni mayaṃ bhavantaṃ raṭṭhapālaṃ payirupāsissāmā'ti.

32260.meaningLit: for the sake of a gift

examples.text: ārogy'atthāya moceti, sukh'atthāya moceti, bhesajj'atthāya moceti, dān'atthāya moceti, puññ'atthāya moceti, yaññ'atthāya moceti, sagg'atthāya moceti

32262.commentary: (SNa) dānapatī'ti yaṃ dānaṃ demi, tassa pati hutvā demi, na dāso na sahāyo.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, sīha, dāyako dānapati yaṃ yadeva parisaṃ upasaṅkamati, yadi khattiyaparisaṃ yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṃ yadi gahapatiparisaṃ yadi samaṇaparisaṃ, visārado'va upasaṅkamati amaṅkubhūto.
bhūtapubb'āhaṃ, bhante, sirī nāma rājā ahosiṃ dāyako dānapati dānassa vaṇṇavādī.

32263.meaning1: source of charity; stream of generosity
32263.commentary: (VINa) dānapathānī'ti dānāni'y'eva vuccanti. atha vā dānapathānī'ti dānanibaddhāni dānavattānī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

32264.meaning1: highest state of generosity; perfection of giving
32264.meaning2: highest state of generosity; perfection of giving
32264.commentary: (APAa) bāhirakabhaṇḍapariccāgo dānapāramī nāma, aṅgapariccāgo dānaupapāramī nāma, jīvitapariccāgo dānaparamatthapāramī nāmā'ti dasa pāramiyo dasa upapāramiyo dasa paramatthapāramiyo'ti samattiṃsa pāramiyo telayantaṃ vinivaṭṭento viya mahāmeruṃ matthaṃ katvā cakkavāḷamahāsamuddaṃ āluḷento viya ca sammasati.

examples.text: vicinanto tadā dakkhiṃ, paṭhamaṃ dānapāramiṃ, pubbakehi mah'esīhi, anuciṇṇaṃ mahāpathaṃ.
ehi amma piyadhīti, piyā me dānapāramī, hadayaṃ me'bhisiñcetha, karotha vacanaṃ mama.

32265.meaning1: fruit of giving; result of generosity

examples.text: atha kho sīho senāpati yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi. ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho sīho senāpati bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, sakkā nu kho, bhante, bhagavā sandiṭṭhikaṃ dānaphalaṃ paññāpetun'ti?
laddheyyaṃ labhate macco, tattha dānaphalaṃ kuto, n'atthi dānaphalaṃ deva, avaso devavīriyo.

32266.meaning1: made by giving; produced by charity
32266.meaning2: made by giving; produced by charity
32266.commentary: (ANa) dānam'eva dānamayaṃ, dānacetanāsu vā purimacetanāto nipphannā sanniṭṭhāpakacetanā dānamayaṃ sīl'ādīhi sīlamayādīni viya.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekaccassa dānamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu parittaṃ kataṃ hoti, sīlamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu parittaṃ kataṃ hoti, bhāvanāmayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ n'ābhisambhoti.
kusalā cetanā kām'āvacarā rūp'āvacarā dānamayā sīlamayā bhāvanāmayā, ayaṃ vuccati puññ'ābhisaṅkhāro.

32268.meaning1: produced by generosity; derived from offering
32268.commentary: (SNa) dānasambhūtānī'ti dānena sambhūtāni nibbattāni. sesapadadvaye'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: atha kho yāni tāni kulāni aḍḍhāni mahaddhanāni mahābhogāni pahūtajātarūparajatāni pahūtavitt'ūpakaraṇāni pahūtadhanadhaññāni, sabbāni tāni dānasambhūtāni c'eva saccasambhūtāni ca sāmaññasambhūtāni ca.

32269.meaning1: giving and sharing; offering and distributing
32269.commentary: (DNa) dānasaṃvibhāge'ti ettha ca dānam'eva diyyanavasena dānaṃ, saṃvibhāgakaraṇavasena saṃvibhāgo.

examples.text: yam'pi, bhikkhave, tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussabhūto samāno daḷhasamādāno ahosi kusalesu dhammesu, avatthitasamādāno kāyasucarite vacīsucarite manosucarite dānasaṃvibhāge sīlasamādāne uposath'upavāse matteyyatāya petteyyatāya sāmaññatāya brahmaññatāya kule jeṭṭh'āpacāyitāya aññatar'aññataresu ca adhikusalesu dhammesu.

32270.meaning1: loving to give and share; who delights in sharing gifts; who enjoys distributing charity

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati muttacāgo payatapāṇi vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, cāgadhanaṃ

32272.meaning1: accustomed to giving; in the habit of donating

examples.text: dāyako'ti dānasīlo. dānapatī'ti yaṃ dānaṃ demi, tassa pati hutvā demi, na dāso na sahāyo.

32280.meaning1: grounds for giving; reason for donation

examples.text: aṭṭha dānavatthūni. āsajja dānaṃ deti, bhayā dānaṃ deti, adāsi me'ti dānaṃ deti, dassati me'ti dānaṃ deti, sāhu dānan'ti dānaṃ deti, ahaṃ pacāmi, ime na pacanti, n'ārahāmi pacanto apacantānaṃ dānaṃ na dātun'ti dānaṃ deti, idaṃ me dānaṃ dadato kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchatī'ti dānaṃ deti.
kālakañcā mahābhismā, asurā dānaveghasā, vepacitti sucitti ca, pahārādo namucī saha.

32283.meaning2: distributor of alms or who serves in feeding

examples.text: pubbakāraṃ karotī'ti dān'ādikaṃ kusalakiccaṃ paṭhamataraṃ karoti.

dhammikā kho devā, adhammikā asurā, idh'eva dān'āhaṃ devapuraṃ gacchāmī'ti, atha kaṇṭhapañcamehi bandhanehi muttaṃ attānaṃ samanupassati, dibbehi ca pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappito samaṅgībhūto paricāreti.
sve dān'āhaṃ sake nivesane bhagavato vādaṃ āropessāmī'ti bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, adhivāsetu me, bhante, bhagavā svātanāya attacatuttho bhattan'ti.
atha kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, handa dāni, bhikkhave, āmantayāmi vo, vayadhammā saṅkhārā appamādena sampādethā'ti. ayaṃ tathāgatassa pacchimā vācā.
pariccattaṃ kho rañño nāgassa jīvitaṃ. n'atthi dāni kiñci rañño nāgassa akaraṇīyan'ti.
yehi manussā āgataṃ bhikkhuṃ na manasi karonti, tatra bhikkhussa evaṃ hoti, kosu nāma idāni maṃ imasmiṃ kule paribhindi, virattarūpā dān'ime mayi manussā'ti
paṇḍupalāso'va dāni'si, yamapurisā'pi ca te upaṭṭhitā, uyyogamukhe ca tiṭṭhasi, pātheyyam'pi ca te na vijjati.
upanītavayo ca dāni'si, sampayāto'si yamassa santike, vāso te n'atthi antarā, pātheyyam'pi ca te na vijjati.
aṭṭha dān'ūpapattiyo. idh'āvuso, ekacco dānaṃ deti samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā annaṃ pānaṃ vatthaṃ yānaṃ mālāgandhavilepanaṃ seyy'āvasathapadīpeyyaṃ.
anāpatti asañcicca, assatiyā, ajānantassa, dassāmī'ti vā dāpessāmī'ti vā oloketi, na ujjhānasaññissa, āpadāsu, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

32299.meaning1: having caused to give; having had given (to)
32299.commentary: (VIN 2.5.5.2) tassa dāpetvā'ti yāguṃ vā bhattaṃ vā khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā dāpetvā

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ, eh'āvuso, gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisissāmā'ti tassa dāpetvā vā adāpetvā vā uyyojeyya, gacch'āvuso, na me tayā saddhiṃ kathā vā nisajjā vā phāsu hoti
